description: Test helper module for delivering mock outbound messages in a testing environment, including mock implementations, registry setup, and utility functions for testing WhatsApp delivery.

methods.name: resetDeliverTestState
methods.description: Resets the mock state and registry to default values for testing.

methods.name: clearDeliverTestRegistry
methods.description: Clears the current plugin registry and sets it to an empty registry.

methods.name: resetDeliverTestMocks
methods.description: Clears all mock call histories; optionally includes session mocks.

methods.name: runChunkedWhatsAppDelivery
methods.description: Simulates chunked WhatsApp message delivery with configurable payloads and mirroring.
